# The Viper Group
Formerly a privateering company operating under the wing of a now-destroyed Syndicate operations branch, domineered by military discipline with the sole mission of disrupting interstellar shipping routes along the fringes of occupied space. After the Great Expansion ripped the galaxy apart, the Viper Group saw an opportunity to exploit the galactic situation after the devastation and formed a branch office in the outer Perseus arm to facilitate local operations, offering a variety of services such as detail security and targetted hits to various groups of interest.
Post-Expansion the Vipers had entirely migrated into the Perseus arm with a PMC front, moving away from being associated publicly with various large-scale governing bodies which made extensive use of their services and acting independently. With the PD - TSF frontlines growing ever-more volatile and unprofitable as their spheres of influence and arsenal of mass destruction grew to their limits, the Vipers nested deeper in their domain laying in wait for more lucrative endeavours.
The Vipers expanded their reach to target more opportunistic areas where one would not look twice their way upon catching their insignia, such as destabilized frontier planets and spacehubs of various groups of interest as they became notorious for conducting raids on everyday supply routes and forgotten blacksites of long gone occupants, sometimes lending locals of their operating area aid with rogue automated units when not directly involved in the territorial conflict of the PD and TSF. With leadership often violently switching hands once a Viper commander's fangs grow dull, the Vipers are seen as a wildcard whose only interest is credits and fullfilling contracts to the letter.
